name: Statistics, Joined Analysis and Publication Figures
purpose: Convert raw scenario-level predictor and scheduler outputs into defensible statistical evidence and publication-ready figures/tables.
work_items: join ADE/FDE with link-fidelity and realized communication outcomes
run paired t-test sensitivity analysis where appropriate
compute effect sizes and win fractions
apply Holm correction within predeclared families
generate system, calibration, ablation, scheduler, horizon, operating-region, slice and complexity figures
generate CSV and LaTeX tables from frozen raw artifacts
acceptance_criteria: raw and adjusted p-values are exported together
effect sizes and confidence intervals accompany significance tests
figures/tables are generated from immutable final inputs
negative and positive operating regimes are both visible
forbidden: treating trajectory rows as independent samples
selecting statistical tests after inspecting favorable outcomes
manual transcription of headline numbers into figures
